context: Whole family helps Hiroshi-elder move to a small new apartment; many voices.
purpose: Multi-voice gentle family helping with major life change.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 新しい家、ドキドキするわ。
lines.en: A new home… it makes my heart race a little.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Warm anticipation beneath the nerves. Slight pause before the confession—like he's deciding whether to let the excitement show. Tender, careful breath.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おとうさん、皆で手伝うで!
lines.en: Dad, we're all helping you with this!
lines.style: Hearty and grounded. A reassurance delivered without fanfare. The voice of someone who means what he says. Kansai warmth wrapping around practical devotion.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Soft inquiry with genuine care underneath. She's present—checking in, making sure nothing's been forgotten. Attentive without fussing. A small nod in her voice.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、ここ、明るいね!
lines.en: Grandpa, this place is so bright!
lines.style: Immediate delight. Her voice lights up as she looks around. Sunny without trying. An eight-year-old's genuine joy at noticing something good. No filter, no agenda.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: My new room is so fun!
lines.style: Quiet wonder that catches you. Six years old, taking it in. Not shouting joy but radiating it. The small genuine laugh of someone discovering something good.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: お祝い、ラーメン、用意したで!
lines.en: I made celebration ramen for us!
lines.style: Loud, generous announcement. All Kansai boldness and blunt affection. She's already taken over the kitchen in spirit. Proud of what she's done. No apologies for the volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: これからも、いつでも、来るで。
lines.en: From here on out, I'll come anytime you need me.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not performing loyalty—stating it like a fact. Warm Kansai undercurrent. The kind of promise you make once and then keep.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 皆の助け、本当にありがたい。
lines.en: I'm truly grateful for everyone's help.
lines.style: Dignified but tender. The voice of someone who knows what gratitude means and isn't being polite—he's genuinely moved. Slight tremor of emotion he's keeping steady.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Family takes care of family. That's just how it works.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact warmth. Like he's stating something obvious that the world needs reminding of. Pride in the Kansai way—generous, unsentimental, rock-solid.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お父さん、これからもよろしく。
lines.en: Dad, I hope you'll let us help you going forward too.
lines.style: Gentle but clear. A tender offer wrapped in respect for his independence. She's soft-spoken but the request carries weight. Affectionate without clinging.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、毎週来るね!
lines.en: Grandpa, I'm coming to visit every week!
lines.style: Sunny promise. Pure child enthusiasm without irony. She means it in the moment and will probably mean it for months. An eight-year-old's solemn vow disguised as joy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 僕も、たくさん遊びに来る!
lines.en: I'm going to come visit you lots and lots!
lines.style: Earnest small voice. He's thought about this already—the idea of visiting matters to him more than he expects. Genuine eagerness with a touch of quiet determination underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: みんなおって、寂しくないわ。
lines.en: With all of you here, I won't be lonely.
lines.style: Contentment settling in. The relief in his voice is real. Not sappy—just the truth, simply said. A quiet acceptance of how much he's loved. Breath eases at the end.
